sourceFindings.entrypoint: The CI workflow installs Node 22, Go 1.24.x, npm dependencies and Playwright Chromium, then invokes the default bash run-compiled-frontend.sh with no --compiled-only flag. The script preserves run-typed-composition.sh, selects Go 1.27.3 for the compiled suite, and invokes compiled-frontend/run.mjs.
sourceFindings.buildAndPins: run.mjs records Go/Node/React/ReactDOM/esbuild/Playwright versions and command logs; hashes source files before/after; compiles four apps (counter/form/list/effect); records a build request/result and validates every compiler output's byte count and SHA-256 both before and after conformance/demo. The compiler pipeline publishes GoScript TypeScript plus app IR, gobi-compiled modules, encoders, and the shared React map in its output inventory.
sourceFindings.demoBundle: demo/build.mjs imports exactly the four generated gobi-compiled modules and their encoder modules, bundles them with esbuild as browser ESM, and copies index.html. The execution receipt source shown here does not itself add a digest/byte inventory for demo.bundle.mjs, demo entry.mjs, demo.png, or demo-smoke.json; the downloaded artifact can be hashed independently, but those per-file hashes must not be attributed to a receipt field that is absent.
sourceFindings.httpSmoke: demo/smoke.mjs serves the built demo over a dynamically assigned 127.0.0.1 HTTP port using node:http, launches headless Playwright Chromium, navigates to the demo URL, waits until four sessions mount, and drives counter Add/Add/Reset, controlled form/checkbox/save/literal argument, keyed list edit/reorder, and one manually delivered effect request. It checks pending/disabled effect UI and one captured reply, asserts empty runtime failures/pageerror/wasm-request arrays, and writes a full-page demo.png only after the successful checks.
sourceFindings.wasmGuard: app.mjs replaces callable WebAssembly Module/Instance/compile/instantiate/compileStreaming/instantiateStreaming APIs with throwing guards and records four runtime sessions. The smoke captures any .wasm request and requires none.
sourceFindings.errorCoverageLimit: The smoke records pageerror and runtime onFailure events. It does not explicitly record console.error, requestfailed, or assert the navigation response status; interaction and mount assertions still require the served page and bundle to work.
